content.title: Continuous Emotion Pressure Curve | Restraint, Peak, Concealment, Residue
content.summary: Lock one adult portrait, background, lens distance and light. Accumulate at least three non-resetting facial or breathing pressure indicators, resolve once into a maximum expression, use one brief protective concealment after the peak, then reveal the face and hold visible emotional residue instead of restoring neutrality.

quick_start.input_format: locked adult close portrait, background, light and lens + calibrated neutral baseline + at least three cumulative pressure indicators + exactly one emotional peak + brief post-peak protective concealment + revealed face with persistent emotional residue
quick_start.recommended_input: In one locked control-room close-up, an adult rescue dispatcher accumulates jaw tension, controlled blinks, reddening eyes and a trapped inhale. One safe-return chime releases a single crying peak; she briefly covers her mouth, lowers her hand, steadies her breath and ends with wet eyes still fixed on the status monitor.
required_anchors: Lock one adult portrait, background, lens distance and light for the complete performance.
Accumulate at least three readable tension indicators without resetting earlier evidence.
Place one brief self-protective concealment gesture after the peak and then reveal the face again.
Hold visible emotional residue such as wet eyes, altered breath or gaze in the terminal state.

applicable_scope: Lock one adult portrait, background, lens distance and light. creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one adult portrait, background, lens distance and light so that performance changes remain directly comparable. Begin from a controlled emotional baseline, accumulate at least three small facial or breathing indicators without resetting them, resolve once into a single maximum expression, then use one brief self-protective concealment gesture. Reveal the face again and end with visible physiological or behavioral residue rather than restored neutrality. The reusable mechanism is calibrated baseline, cumulative restraint, single peak, protective concealment and residual recovery—not the source woman, face, earrings, grey garment, field background, tear pattern, exact expression, camera, timing, creator identity or unsupported model mapping.

invariants.ablation_failure: Camera or lighting changes can impersonate emotional progression.

invariants.purpose: Builds a continuous pressure curve rather than disconnected expressions.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent face poses become an expression test.

invariants.rule: Use exactly one maximum expression after the restrained build.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated peaks flatten the arc into cycling.

invariants.rule: Place one brief self-protective concealment gesture after the peak and then reveal the face again.
invariants.purpose: Adds behavioral consequence while preserving proof of recovery.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending fully hidden removes the final performance evidence.

invariants.rule: Hold visible emotional residue such as wet eyes, altered breath or gaze in the terminal state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instant neutrality erases the cost of the peak.
